title: Predictive model of prognosis index for invasive micropapillary carcinoma of the breast based on machine learning: a SEER population-based study.
summary: The study develops a prognosis index for 1,123 SEER patients with train/test separation and survival outcomes, a specific cancer-prognosis result. Five ML algorithms (SVM, KNN, RF, Extra Trees, XGBoost) model prognosis from SEER invasive micropapillary breast-carcinoma clinical variables. 80:20 split, 10-fold internal CV and independent test metrics validate the retrospective prognostic model.
